children: Allfunds expects the first Project Harmonia tokenized funds to go live on Solana in Q1 2027. The funds will come from the Allfunds cohort, which includes 22 asset managers.
The launch adds tokenized fund activity as a use for the network. When someone makes a transaction involving one of the funds on Solana, the fee for that transaction is paid in SOL.

title: Solana: Allfunds plans launch of first Project Harmonia tokenized funds - Q1 2027
